spiritgiven.comments: Throughout the whole game the fair-mindedness was always amazing, despite the language barrier the communication was good with assistance from translators (coaches, players). During halftime there was a spirit captain talk and the things mentioned there were improved a lot in the second half. And even though it was a tight game we thought the attitude towards us and towards themselves was always respectful.
We thought that there were to many travels even after calling it multiple times. Other than that it was a good game

Overall it was a good game, communication in the matchups and between the Spirit Captains was good. We only gave a 1 in Self-Control because of the talks on the sideline, which we felt were a bit disrespectful towards us (as mentioned in the spirit circle after the game).
Good communication between the matchups and on the field during calls. We liked that everyone respected the view of the other players and tried to solve the calls correct and quickly.

spiritreceived.comments: Great spirit, calm communication despites a lot of calls
Great spirit for such a high intensity game - really appreciated the active communication on the pitch and the sideline :)
All calls discussed well and used media, when necessary, quickly and effectively.
Very good all around, great fair mindedness and good communication and spirit.

Switzerland was extremely willing to talk things out after a call was made, and would rlly listen to our opinions before deciding on the final call. Also Switzerland were very fair with making any calls. Also we could tell they tried to reduce as much contact as possible, apart from some bids that might have resulted in more contact on both sides. But we appreciate them talking out the amount of contact they are willing to accept, and carry on the game from there. Thank you Switzerland!
they had great attitude throughout entire game, were physical however we weren’t concerned with their level of contact
